description: This file defines the 'Netlink' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages a netlink socket to query network interface information such as default routes and gateways. It includes necessary header files, macro definitions, and class declarations for network communication functionalities.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Helper class to manage a netlink socket for retrieving network parameters, including methods to connect, read messages, and get default interface information.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the netlink socket with specified groups.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the netlink socket into a buffer.

methods.name: getDefaultInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves default network interfaces and gateway addresses, supporting IPv6 if specified.

methods.name: sockfd
methods.description: Returns the socket file descriptor used for netlink communication.

methods.name: displayMessages
methods.description: Displays messages from a provided buffer.

methods.name: _waitForReply
methods.description: Waits for a reply message within a specified timeout.

methods.name: _sendRouteRequest
methods.description: Sends a route request, optionally for IPv6.

methods.name: _getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message from the socket with a timeout.

methods.name: _getRoutesInformation
methods.description: Gathers routing information such as default interfaces and gateways.

methods.name: _parseRoute
methods.description: Parses routing message data to extract interface index, destination, and gateway.
